description: Search product recall announcements from the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), China: about 1,400 announcements since 2018, newest first. Mostly motor vehicles and motorcycles, plus some consumer goods (power banks, vacuum flasks). Filter by title text (Chinese company or product, some English brands), inferred category, and date range. Returns id, title, date and category; pass an id to china_get_recall for the full notice.

category.description: Inferred from the title. Default all.

offset.description: Skip this many matches, for paging.

query.description: Text in the announcement title, e.g. 特斯拉, 充电宝, 小米, or tesla / power bank.

name: china_search_recalls
title: China Search Recalls
